title: The exact Turán number of the even wheel $W_{2k+2}$ among non-$3$-partite graphs
summary: Let $\mathrm{ex}(n,H)$ denote the Turán number of $H$. A graph is color-critical if there exists an edge $e\in E(H)$ such that $χ(H-e)<χ(H)$. For a color-critical graph $H$ with $χ(H)=r+1$, Simonovits' chromatic critical edge theorem implies that there exists an $n_0(H)$ such that $\mathrm{ex}(n,H)=e(T_{n,r})$ and the Turán graph $T_{n,r}$ is the only extremal graph provided $n\geq n_0(H).$ Let $W_{2k+2}$ be the even wheel obtained by joining a vertex to a cycle of length $2k+1,$ where $k\geq1$ is an integer.
